name: Input Tag
summary: A field that holds the tags already chosen, and an empty place to type the next one. Removing a tag needs a script; the shapes of the tag and of its remove button do not.
summaryZh: 一个装着已经选好的标签的输入框,外加一个可以继续打字的位置。删掉一个标签需要脚本,而标签和它的删除按钮长什么样不需要。

variants.name: Primary
variants.note: The tags carry the brand colour.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default field needs no modifier class.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring is drawn around the field, because the field is what the reader is typing in.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The field paints the flat control surface and takes the derived disabled colour.

states.name: Clearable
states.note: The field carries a button that empties it.

states.name: Filled
states.note: The field sits on a recessed surface and drops its frame. The light run is the base class on its own.

states.name: Tag effect dark
states.note: The tags sit on the solid brand colour instead of on a tint of it.

states.name: Tag effect plain
states.note: The tags lose their fill and keep their outline.

parts.name: Tag
parts.note: One chosen tag. The variant tints the tags of the whole field, because in CSS the modifier sits on the root.

parts.name: Text
parts.note: The words of the tag. A long tag is cut with an ellipsis rather than pushing the field wider.

parts.name: Remove
parts.note: The button that takes the tag back out. It is a real button, and its mark is drawn from two borders.

parts.name: Input
parts.note: The empty place at the end of the field. It is a real text input, borderless, so the field and the text read as one control.

parts.name: Prefix
parts.note: The mark in front of the tags, so a unit can be written next to them.

parts.name: Suffix
parts.note: The mark behind the field, so a unit can be written next to it.

parts.name: Clear
parts.note: The button that empties the field. It is a real button, and its mark is drawn from two bars.

props.name: variant
props.description: Which colour the tags carry. The base class on its own is the neutral tag.
props.descriptionZh: 标签带哪一种颜色。只写基础类就是中性标签。

props.name: size
props.description: The height of the field and the size of its tags.
props.descriptionZh: 输入框的高度和标签的大小。

props.name: value
props.description: The text in the empty part of the field.
props.descriptionZh: 输入框空着的那一格里打的字。

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The hint in the empty part of the field.
props.descriptionZh: 输入框空着的那一格里的提示。

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the field. It becomes the input's aria-label.
props.descriptionZh: 输入框的可访问名称,它会变成 input 的 aria-label。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the field inert. It uses the real disabled attribute on the input, so it leaves the tab order and the field paints the flat control surface.
props.descriptionZh: 让输入框不可用。它用的是 input 上的原生 disabled 属性,因此会退出 Tab 顺序,输入框也会铺上扁平的控件底色。

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the text visible but stops it being edited. It is the native readonly attribute, so the browser refuses the edit. The library does not repaint a read-only field — it is not a state it measures.
props.descriptionZh: 文字仍然可见,但不能编辑。它是原生 readonly 属性,浏览器会拒绝编辑。库不会给只读字段单独配色 —— 这不是它测量过的状态。

props.name: model-value
props.description: The bound value. It answers to `v-model` as well as to `value`, and the binding wins when it is there.
props.descriptionZh: 绑定的值。它和 `value` 一样能接 `v-model`,而且绑定在的时候以绑定为准。

props.name: clearable
props.description: Puts a button at the end of the field that empties it. The text in the field goes with it; the tags are the host's to take away.
props.descriptionZh: 在字段末尾放一个按钮,按它就把字段清空。字段里的字跟着清掉;标签由宿主来拿走。

props.name: effect
props.description: The surface of the field. The light run is the base class on its own; the filled run adds um-input-tag--filled, and the field sits on a recessed surface instead of in a frame.
props.descriptionZh: 输入框的底面。浅色这一跑就是只写基础类;填充这一跑再加上 um-input-tag--filled,输入框坐在凹陷的面上,而不是坐在一个框里。

props.name: tag-effect
props.description: The surface the tags sit on. The light run is the base class on its own; the dark run puts the tags on the solid colour, and the plain run takes their fill away and leaves the outline.
props.descriptionZh: 标签坐在哪种底面上。浅色这一跑就是只写基础类;深色这一跑把标签放到实色上,无填充这一跑则去掉底色,只留下描边。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The tags already chosen. Each one is a tag holding its text and its remove button.
slots.descriptionZh: 已经选好的标签,每个标签里装着它的文字和删除按钮。

slots.name: prefix
slots.description: The mark in front of the tags.

slots.name: tag
slots.description: The words of one tag. The wrapper writes three tags of its own when the caller has not written any, and this slot is what fills them; the caller's own tags carry their own words.
slots.descriptionZh: 一个标签的文字。调用方没有自己写标签时,包装组件会写三个,这个插槽就是填它们的;调用方自己写的标签,文字也由调用方自己写。

events.name: input
events.description: Fires when the text in the field changes.
events.descriptionZh: 输入框里的文字变了就触发。

events.name: clear
events.description: Fires when the reader presses the clear button. The text in the field goes with it; the tags are the host's to take away.
events.descriptionZh: 读者按下清空按钮时触发。字段里的字跟着清掉;标签由宿主来拿走。

a11y.notes: The empty part of the field is a real text input, so the keyboard and the autofill behave the way the reader expects. Each remove button is a real button with its own accessible name — "Remove Frontend", not "Remove" — because a reader who hears ten of them in a row needs to know which is which. Give the input an accessible name: an aria-label, or a visible label above the field.
a11y.notesZh: 空着的那一格是真的文本输入,键盘和自动填充都会按读者熟悉的方式工作。每个删除按钮都是真按钮,都有自己的可访问名称 —— 是「Remove Frontend」而不是「Remove」,因为一次听到十个同样的按钮时,读者得知道哪个是哪个。给输入框一个可访问的名字:aria-label,或者在框上面写一个看得见的标签。

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Three chosen tags and the empty place to type the next one. The remove mark is drawn from two borders rather than written as a character.
examples.descriptionZh: 三个已经选好的标签,和一个可以继续打字的位置。删除记号是用两条边框画的,不是写出来的字符。
examples.markup: Frontend Nightly Reconciliation

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: The tone of the tags. The base class on its own is the neutral tag; the four variants tint the tags and outline them with the derived colour.
examples.descriptionZh: 标签的颜色。只写基础类就是中性标签;四种变体给标签上淡色,描边则用派生出来的颜色。

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Three heights, and the tags grow with the field. The middle one is the base class on its own, because the base class is already the medium field.
examples.descriptionZh: 三种高度,标签跟着输入框一起长大。中间那个只写基础类,因为基础类本来就是中号输入框。
examples.markup:

notes: Adding a tag and taking one away both need a script, so this component is mostly the two shapes: the tag and its remove button. The field paints the surface and the input inside it paints none — two translucent layers would be a colour no role names. The variant tints the tags of the whole field rather than of one tag, because in CSS the modifier class sits on the root; a per-tag tone needs the host to write the tag's own class. The tag effect is a second modifier on the same root, so the two compose: one says which colour the tag carries, the other says which surface it sits on.
notesZh: 加标签和删标签都要脚本,所以这个组件基本上是两副样子:标签本身,和它的删除按钮。输入框负责画底色,里面的 input 什么都不画 —— 两层半透明叠起来就是一个谁都没命名的颜色。变体染的是整个输入框里的标签,而不是单个标签,因为在 CSS 里修饰类挂在根上;想让单个标签带上自己的颜色,得由使用方把类写在那个标签上。标签效果是挂在同一个根上的第二个修饰类,所以两者可以叠加:一个说标签带什么颜色,另一个说标签坐在哪种底面上。
